channel.title: Pier & Point · 700 Indiana St
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 700 Indiana St (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 700 Indiana St: 700 Indiana Street is described as a laboratory building
item.description: 700 Indiana Street is described as a laboratory building. SF YIMBY names Dewey Land Company and MBC BioLabs as responsible for the application; no source read says a lease has been signed. The Board of Supervisors' September 2024 vote affirmed only the CEQA exemption; a Board of Appeals hearing was reported and its outcome was not found. The 70,650 and 72,349 square-foot figures come from different documents; the 48-foot and 54-foot heights are the same measurement without and with rooftop equipment. Source: https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/2025010779 ; https://www.sfbos.org/sites/default/files/m24-0089.pdf ; https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/bag092424_agenda.pdf ; https://sfyimby.com/2025/02/environmental-streamlining-for-700-indiana-street-in-dogpatch-san-francisco.html ; https://www.potreroview.net/short-cuts-95/.

item.title: Correction · 700 Indiana St: The 700 Indiana page now gives its distance to the nearest tracked…
item.description: The 700 Indiana page now gives its distance to the nearest tracked Pier 70 feature as about 360 meters (it said 470) and cites the Board of Supervisors' Motion M24-089, approved 9-1 on September 24, 2024; an earlier 8-2 vote in the minutes was the failed motion to table. Source: San Francisco Board of Supervisors, Motion No. M24-089 (sfbos.org/sites/default/files/m24-0089.pdf); Board of Supervisors minutes, 2024-09-24 (sfbos.org/sites/default/files/bag092424_minutes.pdf, pp.812-813); DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn).

item.title: Correction · 700 Indiana St: The 700 Indiana page now cites the Board of Supervisors' minutes of…
item.description: The 700 Indiana page now cites the Board of Supervisors' minutes of Sep 24, 2024 for the 9-1 vote affirming the CEQA exemption (Supervisor Walton dissenting); Potrero View's 'eight-to-two' matches the failed motions to table and reverse. It no longer says the vote cleared the project to proceed: a separate Board of Appeals appeal (No. 24-040) was open, and Potrero View reported in January 2025 that it was withdrawn (the Board of Appeals' own record was not read). MBC BioLabs is now described as applicant and operator, not the end tenant. Source: Board of Supervisors minutes, 2024-09-24 (sfbos.org/sites/default/files/bag092424_minutes.pdf); Board of Appeals notice, Appeal No. 24-040; Potrero View Short Cuts, 2025-01-27 (potreroview.net/short-cuts-97/).

item.title: Added · 700 Indiana St: New nearby-project record for 700 Indiana St, a proposed lab/office…
item.description: New nearby-project record for 700 Indiana St, a proposed lab/office building for MBC BioLabs next to Pier 70, approved by the Planning Commission in June 2024; the Board of Supervisors rejected a neighborhood CEQA appeal in September 2024. Source: California CEQAnet, 700 Indiana Street Project, Notice of Exemption (https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/2025010779); Citizen Portal, 2024-09-24 (https://citizenportal.ai/articles/6596036/california/san-francisco-county/board-upholds-planning-departments-general-plan-evaluation-for-proposed-dogpatch-biotech-lab-after-heated-ceqa-appeal); San Francisco YIMBY, 2025-02-02 (https://sfyimby.com/2025/02/environmental-streamlining-for-700-indiana-street-in-dogpatch-san-francisco.html).

item.title: Milestone · 700 Indiana St: SF Board of Supervisors approves Motion No. M24-089… (Sep 24, 2024)
item.description: SF Board of Supervisors approves Motion No. M24-089 (File No. 240778) 9-1, affirming the Planning Department's CEQA general plan evaluation exemption and rejecting a neighborhood appeal of the exemption (Board of Supervisors File No. 240777); Supervisor Walton (District 10) cast the dissenting vote and Supervisor Peskin was excused. The Board's minutes of September 24, 2024 also record an earlier 8-2 vote on the same file: Supervisor Walton's motion to table M24-089 failed, 2 ayes (Ronen, Walton) to 8 noes. (Sep 24, 2024). Source: San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2024-09-24; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2024-09-24; City and County of San Francisco, via California CEQAnet Web Portal, 2025-01-24; Citizen Portal, 2024-09-24.
